items.title: US rig count up seven as prices soar
items.summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was up three this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 259 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 263 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is up seven from last week at 588 rigs. A year ago, 544 rigs were active. items.title: U.S. Oil Prices Rise Back Above $80 a Barrel
items.summary: U.S. oil prices extended their summer rally and ended the week 16% higher at $82.49 a barrel, as producers from the Middle East to West Texas bet against the Strait of Hormuz returning to normal soon.

items.title: Baker Hughes wraps up $13.6bn Chart Industries acquisition
items.summary: Chart Industries will become a new reporting segment at Baker Hughes, covering air and gas handling, thermal management and life cycle services.
